senses.gloss: (b. h.; denom. of עָקֵב)to trace, follow.
units: <cite ref="Makkot 10a:1">Macc. 10ᵃ</cite> (expl. <cite ref="P01151"><he>עקבה</he></cite>, <cite ref="Hosea 6:8">Hos. VI, 8</cite>) <he>שהיו עוֹקְבִין להרוג וכ׳</he> they followed up (their victims) to commit murder; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 523">Yalk. Hos. 523</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 30:3">Yalk. Josh. 30</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 787:20">Yalk. Num. 787</cite>.
<cite ref="Sotah 16a:5">Sot. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>בשלשה מקימות הלכה עוֹקֶבֶת מקרא</he> in three instances the practice goes beyond the Biblical text (Ar. Var. <he>עוֹקֶמֶת</he>, <he>עוֹקפֶת</he>).

<cite ref="Sotah 16a:5">Ib.</cite> <he>כי קא חשיב עוקבת ועוקרת וכ׳</he> he (R. Joh.) counts such cases only where the practice goes beyond and overthrows (the text), whereas in this case <he>עוקבת ומוספת</he> the practice goes beyond and adds to (the text).
